boundedFindings.Node: Reviewed fs.open path converts JS flags to an integer, passes integer permissions/flags to uv_fs_open, then libuv uses POSIX open(req->path, flags, mode). JS fs mode is permission bits, not the C fopen MODE string. This selected path does not expose a ccs suffix. Other Node/native/OpenSSL stdio paths not exhaustively traced.
boundedFindings.Prisma: Prisma/client/engines6.19.3 package files match exact image rows. Generated client declares engine c2990dca591cba766e3b7ef5d9e8a84796e47ab7, sqlite provider and operator DATABASE_URL; runtime loads the exact library through process.dlopen. Login username and configuration values become Prisma query fields. Direct account reader binds user ID to a fixed statement and opens operator-resolved file with node:sqlite readOnly/allowExtension:false. Neither selected app call supplies a C MODE string. Rust engine/SQLite and migration engine internals are opaque: package/engine labels are not a source-equivalence or fopen-mode proof.

boundedFindings.libvips: Middleware explicitly exempts /_next/image. Fixed inline image config enables default optimizer, remotePatterns/domains are empty, localPatterns not restricted by a declared list. Next validates url/w/q, fetches permitted internal bytes and calls sharp(buffer, fixed decode options), then resize/format/toBuffer. Sharp descriptor treats strings as file names and Buffer as bytes; this path is Buffer. Exact sharp0.35.5 and libvips8.18.7 native rows are pinned. No externally supplied C MODE/ccs option was identified in these JS boundaries, but native codecs/format metadata and transitive open-mode construction are not proved safe by these wrappers. No image request was executed.
